archetype: Pastel & Soft mixed with Swiss Neo-Brutalism (Gen Z Approachable + Trusted Tech)

typography.font_strategy: The 'Editorial Future' - Techy but approachable. Sharp contrast between headings and body.

headings.usage: Use 'tracking-tight' for all headings. For main Hero text use 'text-5xl md:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tighter'.

body.usage: Use 'leading-relaxed' for readability in assessment questions and reports.

labels.usage: Uppercase, tiny, tracking-[0.2em] (e.g., text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em])

rules: No muddy grays. Use stark black (#0A0A0A) for borders and text to ground the soft pastels.
Primary actions use the Brand blue. Secondary/decorative cards use pastel fills with solid black borders.
CRITICAL: Do not use complete transparent background in header or overlays.

surfaces.bento_card: bg-white border-2 border-[#0A0A0A] rounded-2xl shadow-[4px_4px_0_0_rgba(10,10,10,1)] p-6 md:p-8

layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-6, p-8, and p-12 for containers. Ensure padding prevents border collisions.

grids.marketing_student: Mode A: 'Tetris' Grid. Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6 or gap-8. Create asymmetry (e.g., col-span-8 for hero card, col-span-4 for stats).
grids.admin: Mode B: High Density Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4. Every pixel utilized, h-full on children.

motion.interactions: Hover states must include a slight translate (e.g., -translate-y-1) and shadow adjustment. Do NOT use 'transition: all'. Use 'transition-transform transition-shadow duration-200'.
motion.assessment_flow: Use Framer Motion to slide questions in (x: 20, opacity: 0 to x: 0, opacity: 1) to make the quiz feel lightweight.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or crisp rectangles (rounded-xl) with solid borders. Primary CTA gets the neo-brutalist shadow.
components.assessment_cards: One question per screen. Large, touch-friendly answer buttons. Progress bar at the top with a pulsing 'Tracing Beam' effect on the active portion.
components.admin_tables: Shadcn tables. Add 'Grid Borders' style: border-r border-b on cells to expose the skeleton.
components.charts: Use Recharts (via Shadcn) for RIASEC and Mental Ability results. Use pastel colors for radar/bar charts, maintaining high contrast text labels.

icons_and_assets.library: lucide-react (default) mixed with iconoir-react for playful, distinct illustrations.

images.description: Smiling high school student. Use with a slight tilt and a neo-brutalist black border wrapper to feel energetic.
Iridescent AI brain render. Place in a designated 'AI Insights' bento box on the report page.
Teenager with headphones working on laptop. Good for a 'Continue Assessment' or 'Community' card.

accessibility.contrast: Black (#0A0A0A) text on pastel backgrounds guarantees WCAG AA/AAA compliance.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='start-assessment-btn').
accessibility.motion: Respect 'prefers-reduced-motion'. Add aria-hidden to decorative icons.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Neo-Brutalist + Pastel aesthetic. Avoid 'default SaaS' gray shadows and muted blues.
Do NOT use HTML <select> or <input type='date'>. Use Shadcn DropdownMenu and Calendar.
For the assessment UI, prioritize a single-question view with large, easily clickable options and a clear progress indicator.
Do NOT center align the entire app container (no .App { text-align: center; }). Keep text left-aligned for readability, only centering specific hero headers or empty states.
Install `iconoir-react` for distinct icons if needed, but rely heavily on standard Shadcn `lucide-react` with bold stroke-widths (e.g., strokeWidth={2.5}).
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and neo-brutalist solid borders + shadows.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur), ensuring an opaque base for readability.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on provided image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones.
